svg.title: Application time split for the best tuple of each build
svg.desc: Stacked horizontal bars of median solver time and remaining application time for the fastest solver tuple of each build, one panel per suite. The remainder is application wall time minus solver time and includes start-up, forcing input, and output. Computational diagnostic; no confidence intervals.
